title: Seconds to a clock
description:
Read a number of seconds and print it as hours, minutes and seconds: `H:MM:SS`, with minutes and seconds always two digits, and as many hour digits as needed.

```
Seconds? 3725
1:02:05
```

solution.main.py:
total = int(input("Seconds? "))
minutes, seconds = divmod(total, 60)
hours, minutes = divmod(minutes, 60)
print(f"{hours}:{minutes:02}:{seconds:02}")

hints: `divmod(total, 60)` gives the whole minutes and the seconds left over in one step; do it again with the minutes to get hours.
`{minutes:02}` in an f-string pads a number with zeros to two digits.
